author: NorthEast News Desk
body: A New Bedford woman has been arrested in connection with a weekend house-party shooting in Taunton that left a 22-year-old man dead and seven other people injured, Bristol County District Attorney Thomas Quinn’s office said Wednesday.

Sienna Barboza, 25, was charged with one count of murder and seven counts of armed assault with intent to murder. Officials said she was expected to be arraigned Thursday in Taunton District Court. The charges are allegations, and the case has not yet been resolved in court.

The shooting happened at a gathering on Weir Street. Zirovick Depina of Brockton was killed, while seven others were wounded. The incident prompted local officials to address residents’ safety concerns and call for stronger consequences for repeat violent offenders.

Authorities have not publicly outlined the evidence they say links Barboza to the gunfire or described whether additional suspects are being sought. The district attorney’s office said the investigation remains active. Anyone with information should contact investigators through local law-enforcement channels.
dek: A New Bedford woman faces murder and armed-assault charges after a weekend shooting killed one person and wounded seven.
headline: Woman arrested in Taunton house-party shooting that killed one
